guidelines.sheet: 3x3 sticker sheet, 9 separate characters, equal cells, wide gaps between characters, no character touches its cell edge
guidelines.style: flat vector sticker illustration, bold clean shapes, vibrant colors, friendly proportions
guidelines.background: flat pure green (#00FF00) background, no shadows, no floor, no gradients
guidelines.consistency: same character design, proportions and colors in all 9 cells
guidelines.motion: each character moves in place, no interaction between cells, static camera, seamless loop

plan.sheet_prompt:
One illustration of 9 separate characters arranged in 3 rows of 3, evenly spaced across a single seamless background.
Subject: A pink Barbie doll with long blonde hair, wearing a heart-patterned dress, identical in every cell.
Style: soft 3D clay render, chunky rounded forms, matte material, gentle studio lighting, charming handmade feel.
Outline: none. Draw every character directly on the background with no outline, border, stroke, die-cut edge or halo around it.
Reading left to right, top to bottom, each character shows a clearly different, highly expressive emotion and pose:
Character 1: Barbie smiling sweetly with hearts sparkling in her eyes
Character 2: Barbie blowing a kiss with puckered lips and a wink
Character 3: Barbie shyly looking down with cheeks blushing deeply
Character 4: Barbie with hands clasped over her heart, eyes closed in bliss
Character 5: Barbie looking surprised with wide eyes and an open mouth
Character 6: Barbie laughing joyfully with head tilted back and eyes closed
Character 7: Barbie looking dreamy with half-closed eyes and a soft smile
Character 8: Barbie wringing hands nervously with a worried frown
Character 9: Barbie holding a rose close with a proud smile and confident eyes
Make every expression big and readable at small size: exaggerated eyes, eyebrows, mouth and body language.
Consistency: the same character design, proportions and colours for all 9 characters.
Background: a single, seamless, solid pure green (#00FF00) background covering the whole image in exactly one shade, with no tiled panels, no shading variations, no tint, gradient, vignette or glow, no shadows, no floor, no noise.
Spacing: every character is full body with a generous empty margin on every side (at least 20% of its own size), clearly separated from the others, none touching or crossing another.
plan.video_prompt:
Animate this illustration sheet as a 3-second clip. Every character performs its own big, highly expressive, cartoon-style animation in place, inside its own cell, showing a wide range of emotions:
1. She gently bounces side to side with a soft glowing heart above her head
2. Her hand moves forward blowing a kiss with floating tiny hearts
3. Her head tilts slowly downward as pink blush pulses on cheeks
4. Her chest rises and falls gently as sparkles twinkle around her
5. Her head pops forward slightly with floating question marks and hearts
6. She moves her head side to side with sparkling laughter bubbles
7. Her hair sways gently in a slow breeze with floating hearts
8. Her shoulders tense up and hands twist back and forth anxiously
9. She lifts the rose up and down gracefully while standing tall
Animation style: wide emotions, highly expressive faces and bodies, exaggerated squash and stretch, anticipation and follow-through, clear facial animation (eyes, eyebrows, mouth), secondary motion on ears, tails and props, each character on its own rhythm, lively and full of personality. Never a static pose and never only a gentle sway.
Keep every character inside its own slot of the 3x3 layout; nothing may touch or cross a slot edge, and characters never interact with one another.
Empty slots stay empty: do not add any character, object or effect to them.
Static camera, no zoom, no pan, no cuts. Keep the one flat pure green (#00FF00) background exactly as it is, the same shade everywhere: no shadows, no gradient, no noise, no glow.
Keep each character's design, proportions and colours unchanged and do not add outlines or borders.
